values.binNote: Bin stores the slow as a negative move speed modifier (-0.35 to -0.6); wiki gives the magnitude as a positive percentage (35 to 60). Same numbers, opposite sign convention.
Only relevant against jungle monsters, not usable in a dummy fight against a champion; kept for completeness.

Bin has no direct calculation named EmpoweredDamage; it is computed at runtime as Damage x EmpowerMultiplier=1.4. Wiki's 80*1.4 to 285*1.4 base and 130*1.4% ratio equal 1.4x JayceShockBlast#Damage's base and ratio.

Shock Blast's own castTime field is listed separately from JayceToTheSkies in the sheet's 'other JayceShockBlast' section: castTime: 0.2143. No named row exists there, but this matches the sheet's castTime field for JayceShockBlast.

Sheet lists Shock Blast's own cost field separately under 'other JayceShockBlast': cost: [55/60/65/70/75/80]. No standalone data-value row is named there, but this matches that section's cost field exactly.

mechanics.claim: To the Skies! is a dash that deals damage upon arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: leaps to the target enemy's location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Lightning Field can be cast during the To the Skies! dash, allowing an ability-cast reset/overlap.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Lightning Field|Jayce}} can be cast during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: Shock Blast detonates and deals its damage upon hitting an enemy or reaching max range, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: fires an electric bolt in the target direction that detonates upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Shock Blast becomes supercharged (increased damage) if it passes through Acceleration Gate.
mechanics.quote: If the bolt passes through ''{{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}'', it becomes supercharged: increasing its {{ccs|damage by 40%|physical}}
